name: luma-hosted-event-to-notion

deploy.description: Luma event on the Notion Singapore calendar (private Luma Calendar API integration, new_event) -> skip unless it is in the Luma Managed Events Table -> upsert the Notion Events record keyed on Luma ID (properties + cover) and index it in the Luma Event ID -> Page ID Table. Also fired by luma-manager-email-to-table's backfill.

trigger.authentication_note: Private integration `Luma Calendar API (Unofficial Integration by work.flowers)` (App247901, source work-flowers/zapier-luma-hosted), connection `Notion Singapore Community` holding that calendar's API key. Dennis is not a manager of the calendar, so Zapier's built-in Luma app (OAuth) cannot see it.
trigger.params_note: Empty params = the integration's defaults: every event on the calendar starting from 2 days ago to 365 days ahead. Filtering to Dennis's events happens in code against the Luma Managed Events Table, because Luma's API does not list hidden hosts.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling. The item id is the Luma event id, so each event is delivered ONCE ever (durable dedupe, ticket W6ZE93-VMEWP); there is no update path. An event delivered before Dennis managed it is replayed by luma-manager-email-to-table's backfill.

version_pinning_note: @zapier/zapier-durable 0.14.1 (2026-09-29) and @zapier/zapier-sdk 0.115.1 (2026-10-06) were the newest releases at least 24h old at build time. No zod: nothing imports it.

managed_events.name: Luma Managed Events
managed_events.role: Events Dennis manages. Written by luma-manager-email-to-table; anything not listed is skipped.

luma_events.name: Luma Event ID → Notion Page ID
luma_events.role: Shared with the guest workflow and the retired Luma Zaps.
